_readme: Review queue for the moratorium tracker. Entries are UNVERIFIED leads from a news scan and are never published. To promote one: read the locality's own ordinance or agenda, add a row to MORATORIUMS in src/constants.py with source + as_of + expires, then set this entry's status to 'promoted'. To reject one, set status to 'dismissed' — the scanner will not raise it again.
